chapter: Musicians of the era: players, drummers, bassists, pianists
title: Carl Fontana, Frank Rosolino and Urbie Green
summary: He names Carl Fontana and Frank Rosolino as favorites, and calls Urbie Green the greatest all-around trombonist.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Then, if we want to come up to the modern era of the white trombone players, my favorite is Carl Fontana --
: Uh-huh. I think we've got [a little] kid here in New York who came in and kind of upset New York for a while on Trombone named Urbie Herbie Green.
Oh, I don't even mention Urbie Herbie. I don't mention him because to me Urbie Herbie is the tops over everything.
: That's right, but we want to just get him on record because --
Oh, no, I never mentioned Urbie Herbie Green,
for some reason or other, because you can't say enough about Urbie Herbie-Green.
Urbie Herbie Green's the greatest all-around trombone player in the business --
Any way that you want to mention.
